verdicts.reason: A shrinks 'Build Your Mix' into a tiny chip jammed into a top-left cluster with jumbled flavour pills, so the CTA is buried. The headline wraps to leave 'glow.' orphaned, and the bottom ~30% of the canvas is dead space. B keeps the CTA larger, but it and the pills sit in a gappy grid over the decorative circle. Pill text sizes are inconsistent (WILD HONEY is large, ROSEMARY tiny), 'glow.' is also orphaned, and the legal line sits right under the headline. B is marginally less broken.

A has a sensible top-to-bottom story: headline on one line, can, then a pill grid. But the legal line sits directly under the headline, the logo is tiny, and the CTA is just one pill among six, with smaller text than the flavour pills. Pill text sizes are inconsistent. B buries the CTA in a cramped top-left chip cluster, orphans 'glow.' and leaves a large empty bottom.

B is closest to the original: centred logo, can, one-line headline, then the CTA leading two rows of pills. Flaws: the legal line is moved up under the headline, the CTA is crammed against the PINK PEPPERCORN pill in the same row instead of standing alone, and pill text sizes vary. A buries the CTA in a tiny top-left chip cluster, orphans 'glow.' and leaves the lower third empty.
